key_insight: A tensor-network MPO can model correlated readout errors and mitigate them more accurately than uncorrelated calibration methods.
engineering_relevance: This provides a scalable, near-linear-overhead path to improve measurement fidelity for practical quantum workloads on noisy hardware.
method: Model the readout channel as a matrix product operator (MPO).
Train the MPO on calibration data by likelihood optimization.
Use the learned model for error mitigation in observables, sampling, shadows, and tomography.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports successful validation on a superconducting processor and simulations up to 20 qubits, where the MPO captured correlated readout effects missed by uncorrelated models.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality and coverage of calibration data, and extending the approach to larger or 2D devices may increase inference and optimization complexity.
paper_title: Tensor network characterization and mitigation of readout errors
